name: lw_5175
statement: (x y z : ℝ) (hx : abs x ≥ abs (y + z)) (hy : abs y ≥ abs (x + z)) (hz : abs z ≥ abs (x + y)) : x + y + z = 0
closed: ∀ (x y z : ℝ) (hx : abs x ≥ abs (y + z)) (hy : abs y ≥ abs (x + z)) (hz : abs z ≥ abs (x + y)), x + y + z = 0
informal:
Let $x$ , $y$ and $z$ be three real numbers such that : 

 $ightarrow \hspace{2mm} |x| \geq |y+z| $ 

 $ightarrow \hspace{2mm} |y| \geq |x+z| $ 

 $ightarrow \hspace{2mm} |z| \geq |x+y| $ 

Prove that $ x+y+z=0$
